title: WotC AI Settlement, Chris Perkins Actual Play Return, D&D Beyond Hack – TTRPG News 11/20/2026
summary: Wizards of the Coast seems to be preparing for unionized workers, Chris Perkins returns to streaming for a Daggerheart series, D&D Beyond gets hacked, and authors of DnD novels share in a settlement from AI art theft.
body_markdown:
StartPlaying is back with another roundup of the biggest headlines in tabletop RPGs, so you can catch up and get back to monster slaying.


This week: Wizards of the Coast seems to be preparing for unionized workers, Chris Perkins returns to streaming for a *Daggerheart* series, D&D Beyond gets hacked, and authors of DnD novels share in a settlement from AI art theft.


### **WotC Hiring Labor Relations Specialist In Light Of Union Vote**


Employees for **Dungeons & Dragons** and **Magic: The Gathering** are trying to form a union, and **Wizards of the Coast** seems to see it as inevitable. When last this story left off, WotC hired a[“union avoidance firm”](https://startplaying.games/blog/posts/dnd-warcraft-delays-wotc-union-dan-ayoub-paizo-13-omens) and took a general stance that direct relations with employees are more fruitful. But now the[employees have voted](https://startplaying.games/blog/posts/dnd-union-vote-vampire-6e-playtest-pathfinder-book-ai) on whether or not to form United Wizards of the Coast. In preparation,[Wargamer reports](https://www.wargamer.com/dnd/wotc-hiring-director-labor-relations-union) that WotC posted a new job listing for a **Director of Labor Relations** . The job listing requires one build a plan to work with union representatives.


### **Chris Perkins Takes The GM Seat For Critical Role Daggerheart Series**


Chris Perkins is back in the actual play GM seat, this time for a ***Critical Role*** joint. Perkins will head *Reign of the Weredragon* , a[Daggerheart](https://startplaying.games/play/daggerheart) miniseries based in a campaign frame of his own creation. Perkins helped shape actual play’s popularity with his GMing role on *Acquisitions Incorporated* . Now, he looks to innovate again with two unique elements for *Weredragon* .


One, Perkins will incorporate audience votes via Discord to change the story between episodes. The second is that Perkins will use post-game content to give viewers a behind-the-curtain peek at the Game Master process in hopes that it inspires new GMs to begin their first campaign. The first episode[airs January 13](https://www.enworld.org/threads/chris-perkins-returns-to-actual-play-with-launch-of-critical-roles-reign-of-the-weredragon.721407/) .


### **D&D Beyond Hit By Hack, Payment Info Safe**


D&D Beyond was one of several sites to get breached on Monday as part of the **Optimizely hack** .[EN World reports](https://www.enworld.org/threads/d-d-beyond-one-of-hundreds-of-sites-affected-by-third-party-hack-claims-no-payment-information-was-accessed.721435/) that 178 websites were affected by the hack, which used ads to invade websites and steal payment data. D&D Beyond was safe from this attempt, however, as Executive Producer Brian Perry ensures that the site uses a secure payment provider. So while the site was hit, no payment data was accessed. The Optimizely hack was contained within 3 hours.


### **DnD Novel Writers Get Share of AI Theft Lawsuit Settlement**


Wizards of the Coast took part in a class action lawsuit against **Anthropic** , and now writers of classic DnD novels will reap the spoils. The suit took aim at Anthropic’s use of copyrighted books to train the **AI Claude.** While the judge ruled in favor of that part, Anthropic was found the offender of saving pirated books in a central data bank. A settlement was reached for $1.3 billion, making it the biggest class action ever. WotC plans to share its part of the proceeds with the writers of pirated DnD books included in the library,[reports EN World](http://enworld.org/threads/wizards-of-the-coast-to-share-payout-of-anthropic-copyright-settlement-with-authors-of-stolen-work.721447/) .


‍


Good news for the writers! That’s it for this week. Thanks for reading, and may your dice be kind.
